title: Sciatt
id: MAR-0070

source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 220 g buckwheat flour
- 70 g all-purpose flour
- 120 g Casera or fontina cheese
- 3.5 dl sparkling water
- to taste frying oil,
- to taste salt,
## Method
1. Gather the flours in a bowl with a pinch of salt, mix and add the water, preferably iced.
2. Beat for a few minutes with a whisk to eliminate any lumps, then let rest for an hour.
3. The proportions between buckwheat and white flour can vary, but in any case the latter must be measured in smaller quantities than the former.
4. Cut the cheese into cubes of about 2 cm and add them to the batter, mixing again.
5. Heat plenty of oil in a pan and, when it is well hot, using a spoon, scoop up the cheese cubes one at a time, well coated in the batter, and add them gradually to fry.
6. When the sciatt have taken on an amber color, drain them with a slotted spatula, transfer them to a sheet of kitchen paper towel and serve them still hot.
